text:
lia_support: Customer onded by Jess reporting p95 jump to ~2s and intermittent 502s since ~10:44 UTC. Affects api.redwood.ai/v1/chat; region: eu-west-1. Case #C-1938.
customer_jess: Seeing timeouts in production, some calls fail with 502, others are slow. Non-urgent but blocking UI.
sanjay: Can you share a request-id sample? Also tenant id? I can look at ingress metrics.
lia_support: Tenant: acme-marketing. Sample req ids: r-89f3, r-8b2c. Attach logs: link to case.
ops: Looking at ingress: connection queue length spiked at 10:43, pod gpu-worker-12 CPU 98%, queue_wait_time p95 ~1.6s, p99 ~3.8s.
marta: Checking admission controller events — I see a surge and a protective throttle kicked in for that tenant at 10:44: "ConcurLimitReduced" from 50 -> 16. Might be related to a miscalibrated fairness policy.
sanjay: That's interesting — we deployed an autoscaler tweak yesterday that reduces concurrency aggressively on token bucket exhaustion. Possible refill bug.
lia_support: Customer points out this correlates with a marketing batch job at 10:40 that aggressively hit embeddings endpoint. Could be noisy neighbor.
ops: Quick mitigation: scaled up gpu-pool-3 by +2 nodes at 10:48, and bumped tenant concurrency cap to 40 for acme-marketing. deploy-bot: executed scale action (scale_id=scale-772).
oncall-bot: Alert suppressed for acme-marketing; incident auto-escalation paused.
marta: Can we add a short-term routing rule to send acme-marketing to dedicated queue to avoid head-of-line blocking?
sanjay: Agree. I'll push a canary route to isolate them to pool-4 for 15m. Command: `rctl route set --tenant acme-marketing --pool pool-4 --duration 15m`
ops: After scaling & route change p95 dropped to 320ms and errors subsided. Still watching.
lia_support: Updated customer: we scaled and isolated traffic, asked them to retry. They reported better performance.
customer_jess: Confirming — UI is responsive again, thanks.
marta: Root cause hypothesis: aggressive batch job caused token-bucket exhaustion -> admission controller reduced concurrency too far (bug in refill), exacerbated by shared queue head-of-line blocking. Follow-ups: 1) fix refill logic 2) add per-tenant burst protection threshold 3) add alert for sudden concurrency reductions.
sanjay: I'll open an ENG-ML ticket for refill bug and link this case. ops, can you add a synthetic that simulates burst + checks admission delta?
ops: On it. Created runbook snippet in the incident doc.
lia_support: Closing loop with customer; will reopen if it reoccurs.
